content.intro: reborn/task takes your privacy seriously. We are committed to protecting your personal data.
content.zero_knowledge: Our application uses end-to-end encryption and Zero Knowledge architecture, which means that your task data is encrypted on your device before being sent to our servers. We cannot access the content of your tasks.
collect_list: Encrypted task data (which we cannot read)
dont_collect_list: The content of your tasks (due to encryption)
content.security_text: All sensitive data is encrypted using AES-GCM encryption. Your password is never stored on our servers. We use industry-standard security measures to protect our infrastructure.
content.cookies_text: We use cookies and local storage only for essential functionality like keeping you logged in and storing your preferences.

content.intro: The Reborn Foundation is dedicated to supporting innovative projects that prioritize privacy and data security in the digital age.
content.mission_text: To create and sustain open-source tools that protect user privacy and promote digital rights for everyone.
why_donate: Help maintain infrastructure for free services
Enable research into better encryption methods
Fund educational programs about digital privacy
